proposals.evidence: CDIAL 11493 *vātatrāsa explicitly gives Nepali batās, Bengali bātās and Maithili both batās and basāt wind. The metathesized survey bəsat is thus supported within this exact wind family. Exact survey form bəsat is preserved.
